SELECT to_jsonb(o) || jsonb_build_object('models', COALESCE(to_jsonb(o.models), '[]'::jsonb), 'litellm_budget_table', (SELECT to_jsonb(b) || jsonb_build_object('allowed_models', COALESCE(to_jsonb(b.allowed_models), '[]'::jsonb)) FROM "LiteLLM_BudgetTable" b WHERE b.budget_id = o.budget_id), 'object_permission', (SELECT to_jsonb(op) || jsonb_build_object('mcp_servers', COALESCE(to_jsonb(op.mcp_servers), '[]'::jsonb),
    'mcp_access_groups', COALESCE(to_jsonb(op.mcp_access_groups), '[]'::jsonb),
    'mcp_toolsets', COALESCE(to_jsonb(op.mcp_toolsets), '[]'::jsonb),
    'blocked_tools', COALESCE(to_jsonb(op.blocked_tools), '[]'::jsonb),
    'vector_stores', COALESCE(to_jsonb(op.vector_stores), '[]'::jsonb),
    'agents', COALESCE(to_jsonb(op.agents), '[]'::jsonb),
    'agent_access_groups', COALESCE(to_jsonb(op.agent_access_groups), '[]'::jsonb),
    'models', COALESCE(to_jsonb(op.models), '[]'::jsonb),
    'search_tools', COALESCE(to_jsonb(op.search_tools), '[]'::jsonb),
    'skills', COALESCE(to_jsonb(op.skills), '[]'::jsonb)) FROM "LiteLLM_ObjectPermissionTable" op WHERE op.object_permission_id = o.object_permission_id)) AS "data!: AuthData" FROM "LiteLLM_OrganizationTable" o WHERE o.organization_alias = $1 ORDER BY o.organization_id
